questions.stem: An 82-year-old woman is sent to the hospital from a nursing home after 2 days of fever, confusion, and lethargy. The patient has a history of mild dementia, hypertension, and osteoarthritis. Her temperature is 38.8 C (102 F), blood pressure is 90/60 mm Hg, and pulse is 116/min. She has mild suprapubic and right costo-vertebral angle tenderness. Her leukocyte count is 18,000/mms, and urinalysis is consistent with acute cystitis. A femoral venous access is planned for administration of intravenous fluids and antibiotics. The femoral artery pulsation is palpable immediately below the inguinal ligament. Which of the following describes the optimal cannulation site for the femoral vein?

options.label: A
options.text: Immediately lateral to the femoral artery

options.label: B
options.text: Immediately medial to the femoral artery

options.label: C
options.text: Midway between the iliac crest and the femoral artery

options.label: D
options.text: Superior and medial to the pubic tubercle
